about: Age groups (plans/21-age-groups.md, D-38). Difficulty is one shared scale 1–15 (1 = a 6-year-old can answer it, 10 = a 16-year-old, 15 = trivia specialists); each group plays a window of it. `focus`: the group the authoring pipeline writes for and the game plays today. Windows other than the focus group's are a draft until the game offers the choice (AG-7).
